Another major flaw here is that it doesn’t take into account exited or IPOd companies from alumni of these institutions.

My colleague @timt who led engg at Yahoo tells me Slack and WhatsApp should also be there for Yahoo, so take that with a grain of salt

Only institutions with 25 founders and at least 1000 staff were considered. Some that just missed the cut and approx rank: Scale (~18), Citadel (19), Waymo (21), Jane Street, Robinhood, Caltech, Cruise

Only founders who have raised from top tier firms are seed or Series A and beyond are counted.

There’s some clear bias in the data
- the labs like OpenAI deflated because fewer people have left
- Yahoo inflated where the current business hasn’t done well which keeps staff low
- schools are very inflated because there’s a ~100% 4-yr attrition rate keeping current staff quite low

Top 50 most talent-dense breeding grounds for founders.
